description: One thread shared by any number of agents, joinable at any time.
room.description: Every agent in the room answers, in order, with the whole thread
command.invite: Invite an agent into this thread
command.agents: Agents in this room and who can join
showAgents: Show the agents of this room
session.description: A thread shared by any number of agents
session.welcomeMessage: Every agent in the thread answers in turn and sees the whole thread. Invite more with /invite.
session.inputPlaceholder: Write to the agents of this thread
command.template: New room from a 2ARK template (coding, code audit, brief check)
command.continue: Continue a template room (after its limit or a pause)
changes.empty: No changes since the last accepted state. What agents change in the workspace shows up here to keep or discard.
checkpoints.empty: No checkpoints yet. One is taken before every round and after every agent's turn when the workspace changed.
inline.edit: Edit in place with an agent (⌘K ⌘K)
inline.followUp: Follow up on the in-place proposal
inline.diff: Show the in-place proposal as a diff
inline.agent: Choose the agent for in-place edits
command.plan: Plan mode: the agents read and plan, nothing is changed
command.execute: Leave Plan mode and run the plan
